# seed 100. A guest writes double-width runes, then a new pane makes the tiler
# narrow the pane holding them. The resize drops the continuation half of the
# rune on the edge and leaves the lead in the last column, so the pane renders a
# row one cell wider than its own box.
new-pane
overlay-open 0
resize 60 20
tick
new-pane
guest "世世世\r\n"
new-pane
